```
def is_reasoning_model(model: object, reasoning_models: Iterable[object] | None) -> bool:
	"""Return whether a model matches a non-empty reasoning-model pattern."""
	if not reasoning_models:
		return False

	# Normalize model name by removing non-alphanumeric characters
	normalized_model = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', str(model).lower())
	for pattern in reasoning_models:
		pattern_name = str(pattern).lower()
		# Skip empty or whitespace-only patterns
		if not pattern_name.strip():
			continue
		# Normalize pattern similarly
		normalized_pattern = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', pattern_name)
		if normalized_pattern and normalized_pattern in normalized_model:
			return True

	return False
```
